fit_reason: Whole 2002 Buick Regal sedan listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Yellowed, hazy headlight lenses on both front corners
Dull, flat silver paint on the hood and front bumper
Wet leaves and grime spots across the trunk lid and rear quarter panel
Dusty, dirty-looking lower doors and rear bumper
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2002 Buick Regal. The headlights look pretty yellowed and the silver paint on the hood has gone a bit flat, both of which show up in photos. We do mobile pre-sale details, including headlight restoration and a wash and buff, and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
